Scoped, not started. Ask 4 only (asks 1/2/3/5 shipped in #1847/#1848/#1849). The path is: extract_document emits DocumentOrderSignals -> findOrCreateOrder -> deriveOrderTitle (lifecycle.ts:146), which can only ever produce 'Order — {merchant} (#{ref})' because there is no item field anywhere in the orders schema. Line-item extraction ALREADY EXISTS but only for purchase_invoice documents (schemas/extraction.ts:308 purchaseItem — name/brand/model/serial/qty/unit_price), and most orders arrive as confirmation or shipping emails, which have no such capture. So the work is: an items/summary signal on the order-ish document kinds, a column on orders, a migration, the three tabs, and a prompt change which means an extract_document eval. Coherent M, as JF sized it. seamCaveat: openRequests counts a request no reply correlates to AND whose thread (contextId) carries nothing later from the recipient. Messages sent before contextId existed have only the first test, so they still OVER-report: treat an open request as a prompt to check, never as proof of a dropped ball. Requests older than the horizon are counted as abandoned, not open.
